beats.say: You type one letter, and the page freezes for two seconds.
beats.show: a cursor and a typed letter; a counter runs to 2.0 s. Carries: the counter.

beats.say: Three parts take part in a save: the editor, the save API and the database.
beats.show: the counter shrinks into the Editor box; Save API and Database pop in on their names.

beats.say: Every keystroke sent the whole document through the API to the database.
beats.show: camera follows a pulse from Editor to Database; a page stack rides along. Carries: the row.

beats.say: The change puts a cache beside the API, so only the edited lines travel.
beats.show: a green Cache node grows under the API; the page stack shrinks to one line.

beats.say: One letter, one small save. The freeze is gone.
beats.show: the counter grows above the editor and runs down to 0.1 s; the row stays.
